// Fixed DS-19 non-source witnesses, derived from pinned Test262.
// Foreign source is collected before native emission under ADR 0029.
// Replacement for test/built-ins/Function/call-bind-this-realm-undef.js
// Copyright (C) 2016 the V8 project authors. All rights reserved.
// This code is governed by the BSD license found in the LICENSE file.
(function () {
var other = $262.createRealm().global;
var func = other.$262.evalScript("(function(){return this;})");
var subject;

assert.sameValue(func(), other, 'implicit undefined');
assert.sameValue(func.call(undefined), other, 'explicit undefined');
assert.sameValue(func.call(null), other, 'null');
})();

// Replacement for test/built-ins/Function/call-bind-this-realm-value.js
// Copyright (C) 2016 the V8 project authors. All rights reserved.
// This code is governed by the BSD license found in the LICENSE file.
(function () {
var other = $262.createRealm().global;
var func = other.$262.evalScript("(function(){return this;})");
var subject;

subject = func.call(true);
assert.sameValue(subject.constructor, other.Boolean, 'boolean constructor');
assert(subject instanceof other.Boolean, 'boolean instanceof');

subject = func.call(1);
assert.sameValue(subject.constructor, other.Number, 'number constructor');
assert(subject instanceof other.Number, 'number instanceof');

subject = func.call('');
assert.sameValue(subject.constructor, other.String, 'string constructor');
assert(subject instanceof other.String, 'string instanceof');

subject = func.call({});
assert.sameValue(subject.constructor, Object, 'object constructor');
assert(subject instanceof Object, 'object instanceof');
})();

// Replacement for test/built-ins/Function/prototype/apply/argarray-not-object-realm.js
// Copyright 2019 Aleksey Shvayka. All rights reserved.
// This code is governed by the BSD license found in the LICENSE file.
(function () {
var other = $262.createRealm().global;
var fn = other.$262.evalScript("(function(){})");

assert.throws(other.TypeError, function() {
  fn.apply(null, false);
});

assert.throws(other.TypeError, function() {
  fn.apply(null, 1234.5678);
});

assert.throws(other.TypeError, function() {
  fn.apply(null, '');
});

assert.throws(other.TypeError, function() {
  fn.apply(null, Symbol('desc'));
});
})();

console.log("DS19 call-this-apply complete");
